findings.issue: The new FRONTIER_STATUSES, qualifyFrontierId and mergeResearchFrontier block was inserted between mergeResearchRegistries and its JSDoc. The doc block that says 'Merge research findings registries from all lineages. Deduplicates by findingId...' now sits on `const FRONTIER_STATUSES` at line 758, so editors and doc tooling attach it to the constant, and `function mergeResearchRegistries` at line 800 has no doc comment. Case: any reader or IDE hover on FRONTIER_STATUSES gets the registry-merge description, and hovering mergeResearchRegistries gets nothing. Fix: move the five-line JSDoc (lines 753-757) down so it sits directly above line 800, `function mergeResearchRegistries(lineageData, options = {})`, and leave the frontier block above it with its own `//` comments.

expansiveLineageBudgets hard-codes the native lineage's default budget as a bare `12`. The same value already appears as a bare literal at lines 1305, 1858 and 1928 (review.magic-literals, review.dry). Its comment says the floor is 'the budget that lineage would otherwise have run', so the floor is only correct while all four literals agree. Case: if someone changes the native default at line 1858 (`lineage.iterations || 12`), a native lineage dealt no seed node under expansive depth still gets 12 iterations and no longer matches the budget it would otherwise have run. Fix: name the value once (for example DEFAULT_NATIVE_LINEAGE_ITERATIONS = 12) and use it at all four sites.
